name: İyi Finans
verdict: The savings-finance (tasarruf finansmanı) brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş., wholly owned by its chairman Ali Emre Ballı.
note: Rating note: 100% of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş. belongs to Ali Emre Ballı, per the company's 2025 activity report (iyi-finans-balli-ownership); private Turkish company, no state stake and no human-rights finding found. Below the back number on Fenerbahçe Tarfin's league shirts (FenerMedia, 18 September 2026) and on Beşiktaş's men's basketball shirt until the end of 2026-27 (club statement, 21 September 2026).
